name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 40

clue.text: One among possible terms applied to foremost of orchestrators?
eering at second C major piece...
..second, with high notes — or highest
Piano key repeated for Spanish nobleman
This is too rhythmical, surely, for a lullaby!
Unseemly? Reportedly snoozed after opening of Jolanthe
‘Hear, hear!’ for composer
Set up instrument on wrong side
A flat aside, males start in tune!
That is the sound of imitation birdsong
Piece of music from diminutive man at party
Sombre, here, modulating into C minor...
...1’m gripped by blues — perversely exalted
One who asks quickly for Debussy in fashionable heart of Paris
With a stringed instrument on board, greets...
...famous orchestra (with new leader) getting on the ship
I’m turning up with half section of orchestral wind
Looks forward to Chopin’s Prelude among former favourites
Zither music has an element of warmth
Obliterate redundant run
Fabulous festive trio, first in concert
Trumpet and French woodwind (earlier form)
Such as play sittars — or are they associated with pipes?
Was visiting artiste improvising e.g. duets?
Drummer, apparently, who makes a habit of puncturing the skin!
Learning Mass in G
Stops somewhere in bar (rest signified)
One girl or another on audible part of glockenspiel
Struggle with extract from last quarter of canticle
